title: archidendron kunstleri
intro: Archidendron kunstleri, commonly known as the kuping, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family, Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine and is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The kuping is said to have therapeutic actions such as wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in the kuping include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
